name: App Icon: Shadow Kasa Master
purpose: Primary App Store Icon — Wandering Ronin Master.
description: Cinematic side-profile silhouette of a wandering master samurai wearing a traditional conical straw kasa hat, resting a glowing crimson-edged katana on shoulders against a giant circular blood moon.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D vector game app icon. Dramatic profile silhouette of a wandering ronin samurai wearing a wide conical straw kasa hat, holding a sleek katana blade with glowing crimson-red accents resting over shoulders. (Framed entirely within a giant perfectly smooth solid circular crimson-red blood sun:1.4). Pure solid pitch-black background (#07080C), high contrast silhouette poster art, razor-sharp clean edges, pristine vector shapes, no face details, no 3D, no painting, no text, no pixelation, no aliasing.
